name: MC附魔台
author: 然而问
description:
为《杀戮尖塔2》加入 Minecraft 风格的卡牌附魔系统。收集书本提升可附魔等级，并在篝火或先古之民处为卡牌赋予独特的附魔效果。

Adds a Minecraft-inspired card enchanting system to Slay the Spire 2. Collect books to unlock higher enchantment tiers, then enchant your cards at Rest Sites or Ancient locations with unique effects.
